cyclomatic_complexity.name: Cyclomatic
cyclomatic_complexity.description: number of independent paths through the code.

cognitive_complexity.name: Cognitive
cognitive_complexity.description: A qualification of how hard it is to understand the code's control flow.

new_lines.name: Loc
new_lines.description: The number of physical lines that contain at least one character.

instability.name: Instability
instability.description: the degree of incoming and outgoing dependencies.

new_coverage.name: Coverage
new_coverage.description: A mix of line coverage and condition coverage on new lines.

lack_of_cohesion.name: LCOM
lack_of_cohesion.description: measures whether a class represents one abstraction (good) or multiple abstractions (bad).
